trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Rollback:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. I rolled back all regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback completed successfully — service is now healthy in all regions with the error rate back down to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the post-rollback recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 (and its staging predecessor v2.3.1-rc) should be investigated before any re-deploy attempt. Also, since v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, a future redeploy of that version would require change-manager approval per policy.
